Rice___Brown_Spot.symptoms: Oval or circular brown lesions with yellow halo evenly scattered across paddy leaf blade.
Rice___Brown_Spot.symptoms_hi: धान की पत्तियों पर पीले छल्ले वाले छोटे अंडाकार भूरे धब्बे।

Rice___healthy.symptoms: Vigorous, dark green upright tillers with clean leaf blades free of lesions or streaks.

Wheat___Powdery_Mildew.symptoms_hi: गेहूँ की पत्तियों की ऊपरी सतह पर सफेद चूर्ण जैसे धब्बे (चूर्णिल आसिता)।

Wheat___healthy.symptoms: Clean green leaves with erect stature and no rust pustules or powdery patches.
Wheat___healthy.symptoms_hi: स्वस्थ हरी पत्तियां, बिना किसी रतुआ या सफेद धब्बे के।

Onion___Purple_Blotch.symptoms_hi: प्याज़ की पत्तियों पर बीच में बैंगनी और किनारे पीले रंग के अंडाकार धब्बे (बैंगनी धब्बा रोग)।

cibrc_chemical.name: Difenoconazole 25% EC (Score)
cibrc_chemical.application_notes: MANDATORY: Add a non-ionic sticker/spreader (Sandovit / Apsa-80 @ 10ml/tank) due to waxy onion leaves.

cibrc_chemical.name: Mancozeb 75% WP
cibrc_chemical.application_notes: Protective contact spray across foliar canopy.

cibrc_organic.name: Trichoderma harzianum 1% WP
cibrc_organic.application_notes: Bio-fungicide preventive for leaf blight protection.

organic_remedies: Foliar spray with Trichoderma harzianum at 45g/15L tank.
Always mix with soap/detergent (sticker) so spray clings to waxy onion foliage.
chemical_remedies: Spray Score (Difenoconazole 25% EC) @ 15 ml per 15L tank + 10ml sticker.
Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 35-40 g per 15L tank + sticker.
preventive_practices: Maintain raised bed drainage to avoid standing water around onion bulbs.

weather_triggers.leaf_wetness_hours: Warm humid weather with dew and morning fog

Onion___Stemphylium_Blight.symptoms: Small light yellow to pale brown spots that coalesce into extended dark brown foliar blight from leaf tips.
Onion___Stemphylium_Blight.symptoms_hi: पत्तियों की नोक से शुरू होकर नीचे की ओर बढ़ता हुआ पीला-भूरा झुलसा रोग।

cibrc_chemical.name: Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP (Saaf)
cibrc_chemical.application_notes: Apply with sticking agent (10ml sticker/tank) for maximum retention.

cibrc_organic.name: Pseudomonas fluorescens 1.5% WP
cibrc_organic.application_notes: Foliar bio-agent spray.

organic_remedies: Spray Pseudomonas fluorescens with organic wetting agent.
chemical_remedies: Spray Saaf (Carbendazim + Mancozeb) @ 30-35g per 15L tank + sticker.
preventive_practices: Avoid excessive sprinkler irrigation late in the evening.

weather_triggers.leaf_wetness_hours: Prolonged leaf wetness with cloudy periods

Onion___healthy.symptoms: Upright, tubular waxy bluish-green leaves with healthy growing tips.
Onion___healthy.symptoms_hi: स्वस्थ और खड़ी पत्तियां बिना किसी बैंगनी या पीले धब्बे के।

cibrc_organic.name: Neem Oil 10,000 PPM (Preventive)
cibrc_organic.application_notes: Routine bio-spray to keep foliage pest-free.

organic_remedies: Apply balanced potash and sulphur to support bulb swelling.
chemical_remedies: No chemical treatment required.
preventive_practices: Monitor for onion thrips (piliya) in leaf axils.
Onion___healthy.tanki_quick_dose: No chemical needed. Crop leaf is healthy!
